summary: The target lacks essential security headers and has some misconfigurations that could expose it to various attacks. Immediate action is needed to mitigate these risks.

findings.title: Missing Content Security Policy (CSP)
findings.why_it_matters: CSP helps prevent cross-site scripting (XSS) attacks by controlling which resources are allowed to load.
findings.suggested_action:
Add the following CSP header to your web server configuration:

```nginx
add_header Content-Security-Policy "default-src 'self';";
```

For Express.js using Helmet:

```javascript
helmet.contentSecurityPolicy({ directives: { defaultSrc: [\'self\'] } })
```

findings.title: Wildcard CORS Policy
findings.exploitability: Potentially allows cross-origin resource sharing attacks
findings.why_it_matters: A wildcard CORS policy can allow any external domain to access your resources, which can lead to data leakage or other attacks.
findings.suggested_action:
Restrict CORS to trusted domains. For example, in Nginx:

```nginx
add_header Access-Control-Allow-Origin "https://trusteddomain.com";
```

For Express.js using Helmet:

```javascript
helmet.cors({ origin: 'https://trusteddomain.com' })
```

findings.title: Server Version Disclosure
findings.exploitability: Eases targeted attacks based on known vulnerabilities
findings.why_it_matters: Disclosing server software and version can help attackers find known vulnerabilities to exploit.

findings.title: Missing X-Content-Type-Options
findings.why_it_matters: This header helps prevent MIME type sniffing attacks by ensuring browsers interpret files according to their declared type.
findings.suggested_action:
Add the following header to your web server configuration:

```nginx
add_header X-Content-Type-Options "nosniff";
```

For Express.js using Helmet:

```javascript
helmet.xContentTypeOptions()
```

findings.title: Missing X-Frame-Options
findings.why_it_matters: This header helps protect against clickjacking attacks by specifying whether a browser should be allowed to render a page in a <frame>, <iframe>, <embed>, or <object>.
findings.suggested_action:
Add the following header to your web server configuration:

```nginx
add_header X-Frame-Options "DENY";
```

For Express.js using Helmet:

```javascript
helmet.frameguard({ action: 'deny' })
```

findings.title: Missing Referrer-Policy
findings.why_it_matters: This header controls the amount of referrer information sent along with requests.
findings.suggested_action:
Add the following header to your web server configuration:

```nginx
add_header Referrer-Policy "no-referrer";
```

For Express.js using Helmet:

```javascript
helmet.referrerPolicy({ policy: 'no-referrer' })
```

findings.title: Missing Strict-Transport-Security
findings.why_it_matters: This header helps protect users from protocol downgrade attacks and cookie hijacking.
findings.suggested_action:
Add the following header to your web server configuration:

```nginx
add_header Strict-Transport-Security "max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains; preload";
```

For Express.js using Helmet:

```javascript
helmet.hsts({ maxAge: 31536000, includeSubDomains: true, preload: true })
```
